comment: Weights for pair scoring. The framework measures; these decide what the
measurements are worth, so policy lives here rather than in the plugin.
Two of these are curves rather than straight lines, deliberately:
proximity falls off with the square of distance, so standing together beats
merely sharing a faction -- without it, two guards on opposite sides of a
market outscored two people already next to each other.
the crowd penalty is zero up to observerTolerance and then climbs steeply.
In this world nobody is shy about it; nobody performs for ten people either.
Privacy is never a veto, only a price. Hostility is the only hard gate.
playerNear is 0 by OWNER'S DECISION: the player is not a factor at all. The
signal is still measured and still published to addons, so one that wants to
care can -- this only stops the framework's own ranking from caring. Set it
back to 0.5 to make a pair think twice while being watched by the player.
ambientQuestsComment: Quests whose aliases hold people as part of ordinary life. Anyone else a quest gives packages to is left alone. Companions are NOT here on purpose: they get their own module (owner, 2026-09-21).
